title: Coplay Jam #1 - Making a game in Unity with AI!
author: msanatan

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: This is awesome! I love seeing jams that focus on creativity through unique tools like Coplay. It instantly reminded me of Orange Vibe Jam, which also celebrates the process of making things with an extra creative twist, not just about the final result but the vibe and experimentation behind it. Feels like both communities share the same spirit of building cool stuff with passion and curiosity.

replies.author: msanatan
replies.body: It's always a good time to try something new :-)

comments.author: PhysicalChampion922
comments.body: It'd be cool except I can't even install coplay

replies.author: msanatan
replies.body:
Yikes! Installation only requires you add this package in Unity: \`https://github.com/CoplayDev/coplay-unity-plugin.git#beta\` 

https://preview.redd.it/cin0vtdjvu1g1.png?width=1824&format=png&auto=webp&s=14ae5ad2251fcb13cdd30f99a42e4f27aa30b5b5

Be sure to add the package from a Git URL! Note, we support Unity 2022 and higher.

  
Shoot me a message or join our Discord (https://discord.com/invite/y4p8KfzrN4), happy to debug what's happening
